text:
Mia: Quick thought — instead of adding another top-level item, what if we group Models + Deployments + Versions under a single collapsible "Models" section with a tiny subnav? Sketch: https://img.redwood/mock/model-grouping.png :eyes:
Jordan: Love the consolidation. My main worry is deep links. If someone bookmarks /deployments/123 we need a stable URL that still navigates into the collapsed group (and highlights the item).
Sam: Agreed. We should define a routing contract: canonical URL stays as /deployments/:id (no hashes) and the client sets sidebar state on route hydrate. That keeps permalinks friendly for external links and SES.
Henry: Two practical asks: 1) add a short animation so users see the group expand (accessibility: prefer prefers-reduced-motion), 2) ensure focus lands on the selected item after expansion for keyboard users.
Mia: Good calls. For the routing contract I'll propose: every leaf route maps to a path with the group implied server-side. Client should not mutate the canonical URL. Example: /models/:modelId/versions/:verId -> expands 'Models' group and focuses the version entry. No hash fragments.
Sam: Implementation note: on route change do a compute: find matching sidebar node, if children are collapsed open them, then call nodeElement.focus(). Also guard with a11y preference: if aria-hidden set on collapsed children, ensure we toggle aria-hidden and tabindex appropriately.
Jordan: UX nit on breadcrumbs — when inside a version, the breadcrumb should show: Models > MyModel > Versions > v1.2 (not the group label twice). Keep parent labels human-readable.
Mia: Agree. We should also show a subtle badge on the group header when the current route is inside it (so users still know why it's expanded).
Henry: Accessibility nits: screen reader should announce "Models group expanded" when it opens. Use role="group" with aria-expanded on the header button. Also add a skiplink to jump to sidebar for people tabbing in.
Design-Bot: Reminder: design review tomorrow 10:30am. Please add annotated flows in Figma by EOD.
Sam: Small routing edgecase — if we have two groups with same child slug (e.g., /projects/:id and /models/:id share :id), prefer longest prefix match when mapping route to sidebar node. Add a deterministic tie-breaker (group order).
Jordan: What about URL normalization? If user lands on /models//v1.2 or trailing slash variants, server should 301 to canonical path to avoid duplicate crumbs/highlighting bugs.
Mia: I'll draft the PR describing the contract: canonical paths, client hydration behavior, focus rules, ARIA semantics, and tie-breaker. Tagging @Sam and @Henry for implementation details.
Henry: If we can, add unit tests around focus and aria attributes, plus an integration test that opens a collapsed group on route load.
Mia: Thanks — will upload the PR link here when ready. Quick poll: prefer 'badge on group header' visual or 'underline on the selected child only'? React with :thumbsup: for badge, :eyes: for underline.
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Sam: :eyes:
Henry: :thumbsup:
Mia: Cool — badge it is. Thanks all, will follow up with Figma and PR.
